decision_provenance: Explicit template clamp-i64-minus10-plus10-v1 under scalar-wrapping-v1; input domain is all i64; endpoints are inclusive -10 and 10.

requirements.text: For an integer x, clamp x to the inclusive range [-10, 10].
requirements.source_excerpt: For an integer x, clamp x to the inclusive range [-10, 10].
assumptions: Integer is signed wrapping i64; this fixed template has no arithmetic operations or excluded inputs.
